title: Prediction Markets Beat the Weather Forecast on Tomorrow's High Temperature
abstract: arXiv:2609.23969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The sooner we receive information, and the more accurate it is, the better planning decisions we can make. Every day, prediction markets let anyone bet on tomorrow's high temperature in cities around the world, creating a market-implied forecast built on dispersed information. We use the past five years of market data from the Kalshi exchange for seven American cities to extract, hour by hour, the market-implied forecast. We use this forecast as a measuring instrument to see how much information about the temperature the market makes public before the public forecasting system does. We race it against the leading American and European weather forecasts. In six of the seven cities we study, the market beats the most accurate single public forecast, the National Blend of Models (NBM). Aggregating every city-day, at the end of the market's first hour of trading it beats the best single public product by about 10 percent in root-mean-square

translated_title: 预测市场在明日最高气温预测上击败天气预报
translated_abstract: 我们越早获得信息、信息越准确，就能做出越好的规划决策。每天，预测市场让任何人都可以对世界各地城市的明日最高气温进行下注，从而形成了一个建立在分散信息之上的市场隐含预报。我们利用Kalshi交易所过去五年针对七个美国城市的市场数据，逐小时提取出市场隐含预报。我们将这一预报作为测量工具，以考察在公共预报系统发布之前，市场公开了多少关于气温的信息。我们将其与美国和欧洲领先的天气预报进行比拼。在我们研究的七个城市中，有六个城市的市场表现击败了最准确的单一公共预报——国家模式混合系统（NBM）。汇总所有城市-天数据后发现，在市场交易的第一个小时结束时，其均方根误差已比最佳单一公共产品低约10%。
tldr: 该研究从Kalshi预测市场五年交易数据中逐小时提取市场隐含气温预报，发现在七个美国城市中的六个，市场预报在交易首小时内就比最准确的官方天气预报（NBM）误差低约10%，证明预测市场能比公共气象系统更早释放气温信息。
en_tdlr: Extracting hour-by-hour market-implied temperature forecasts from five years of Kalshi prediction market data, this study shows the market beats the best official weather forecast (NBM) in six of seven US cities, outperforming it by roughly 10% in root-mean-square error within the first hour of trading.
